message.content: Make and show two pictures, a short video and a sound.

content.text:
Created four files in the folder with ffmpeg, no filter fallbacks needed:

![Test pattern picture](picture1.png)

![Gradient picture](picture2.png)

Video (3 s, 640×360 test pattern, H.264): [clip.mp4](clip.mp4)

Sound (2 s, 440 Hz sine tone, mono WAV): [tone.wav](tone.wav)

The files are `picture1.png`, `picture2.png`, `clip.mp4` and `tone.wav`, and `clip.mp4` is the one with the video.

Not checked: I did not run ffprobe to confirm the durations or that the PNGs open in a viewer; the ffmpeg runs reported no errors and the file sizes look right. Nothing else in the folder was touched.
